title: Simple Analysis of Gel Images With IOCBIO Gel Software
author: Lucia Jaska
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML

steps.title: Install IOCBIO Gel on Linux/Mac
steps.instruction: Upgrade pip with `python3 -m pip install --user --upgrade pip`, open a terminal, navigate to the desired folder, then run either `curl https://gitlab.com/iocbio/gel/-/raw/main/install.sh | bash` or `wget -qO - https://gitlab.com/iocbio/gel/-/raw/main/install.sh | bash`. Launch the program with `iocbio-gel/bin/iocbio-gel`.

steps.title: Install IOCBIO Gel on Windows
steps.instruction: Download the Windows ZIP release, unpack it anywhere, and start the application by double‑clicking `gel.bat` in the extracted folder.

steps.title: Launch the application
steps.instruction: Linux/Mac: run `iocbio-gel/bin/iocbio-gel` in the installation folder. Windows: double‑click `gel.bat` in the extracted folder.

steps.title: Configure initial settings
steps.instruction: On first launch, open Settings (button on the left). Choose Image source (Local files or OMERO) and Database connection (SQLite or PostgreSQL).

substeps.instruction: If using OMERO, enter host name/address, port (default 4064), username, and password.
If using PostgreSQL, enter host name/address, port (default 5432), SSL mode (default ‘prefer encryption’), database name, schema (default ‘gel’), username, and password.

steps.title: Switch to editing mode
steps.instruction: Click the toolbar button in the upper‑right corner to change from viewing (default) to editing mode.

steps.title: Define measurement types
steps.instruction: Select **Types** in the left panel, highlight the Name field, and type each type (e.g., “Ponceau”, “AMPK”).

steps.title: Create projects (optional)
steps.instruction: Select **Projects**, click **Add a new project**, double‑click Name and Comment to edit, and drag‑drop projects to build a hierarchy if desired.

steps.title: Create a new gel entry
steps.instruction: Select **Gels**, click **+ New**, type a gel name, set the reference date/time (or leave blank to use current time), add an optional comment, and assign the gel to a project.

steps.title: Add images to the gel
steps.instruction: With the gel selected, click **Add new image** and load each image file (e.g., Ponceau stain, antibody‑stained image).

steps.title: Select image for analysis
steps.instruction: Double‑click the desired image under **Images**; the Raw tab shows the original image, and the Adjust tab is used for ROI and background steps.

steps.title: Define region of interest (ROI)
steps.instruction: In the Adjust tab, click **Add ROI**; a red square appears. Use the circular handle (upper‑left) to rotate, the diamond handle (lower‑right) to resize, or the rotation slider (upper‑right). Click **Apply** when satisfied.

steps.title: Subtract background
steps.instruction: After ROI, go to the Background tab, specify whether the background is dark or light, choose a subtraction method (Flat, Ball, or Ellipsoid), and if Ball/Ellipsoid, set a radius of at least 500 (larger if needed). Click **Apply** and repeat with a different method or radius if the result is unsatisfactory.

steps.title: Mark analysis lanes
steps.instruction: Switch to the **Lanes** tab, click **Add new lane**, and position the first lane on the image. Repeat for additional lanes (use **+ New** until all desired lanes are placed).

substeps.instruction: The center of each lane appears as a green dotted line; sides are green dashed.
Zoom with the mouse wheel as needed.

steps.title: Adjust lane geometry
steps.instruction: To move a lane, hover over the central line (turns solid red) and drag. To change width, hover over the right‑hand red square (turns yellow) and drag. Use the upper‑right toggle to set **Lane widths: Individual** or **Lane widths: Synced**.

substeps.instruction: To incline a lane, drag the top or bottom red squares.
To curve a lane, double‑click the central line to add extra red‑square handles; drag them to follow the lane shape.
Right‑click a handle and choose **Remove handle** to delete it.

steps.title: Set baseline on intensity profile
steps.instruction: In the right‑side intensity panel, click the plot to activate it, zoom with the mouse wheel, and press the **A** button (lower‑left) to reset view. Double‑click the baseline to add a black square handle, then click and drag to position it. Right‑click a handle to remove it.

steps.title: Obtain signal intensity measurements
steps.instruction: Open the **Measurements** tab, click **Add new measurement** (upper‑right or lower‑right **+ New**), select the measurement type from the Type field, then click on each lane to include it (edges turn solid orange). The Measurement Lanes field will list ID, lane number, intensity value, success tick, and comments.

substeps.instruction: To adjust the height of the measurement region, use the yellow dashed sliders at each end of the intensity profile; drag while holding the left mouse button.
Toggle between **Measurement regions: Individual** and **Measurement regions: Synced** in the upper‑right corner as needed.

steps.title: Analyze additional images of the same gel
steps.instruction: Return to **Gels**, select the same gel ID, double‑click the next image (e.g., antibody‑stained), and repeat the ROI definition, background subtraction, lane marking, baseline setting, and measurement steps.
